image_description: A full-body shot of a large, dark-colored iguana perched vertically on a thick, textured branch or root structure. The iguana has a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, a long tail extending downwards, and visible limbs gripping the perch. The lighting is warm and directional, casting shadows on the right side. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus gradient of brown and orange tones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting a triangular shape. A distinct fold of skin (dewlap) is visible under the chin/jaw area, consistent with iguana anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is visible but appears dark due to lighting and resolution; specific details like pupil shape and iris color (golden) cannot be confidently verified at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The side of the head is in shadow and the resolution is insufficient to distinguish the specific subtympanic shield scale from the surrounding granular scales.
The torso appears thick and muscular, fitting the description of a robust body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana displays dark green/greyish coloration with distinct darker banding across the body and tail, consistent with an adult common iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very prominent, serrated dorsal crest is clearly visible running from the neck down the spine, a defining feature of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the skin shows a mix of smaller scales on the body and larger, more defined plates on the head and limbs, consistent with reptile skin topology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front left limb is clearly visible gripping the branch, showing long toes with claws. The hind limb is also visible. While counting exactly five digits on every foot is difficult due to occlusion, the visible anatomy is structurally correct for an iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is long, extending beyond the visible frame's bottom edge, and appears laterally compressed (flattened side-to-side), which is characteristic of iguanas.
